verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows Pipedream generating or editing a workflow from a natural-language prompt. The closest items are a homepage claim about prompting AI agents, AI-assisted error debugging, and a REST API for creating workflows. These are adjacent capabilities (agent building, debugging, programmatic creation), not prompt-to-workflow generation or editing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can generate or edit a workflow from a natural-language prompt
